description: Token safety / honeypot / rug-risk check. Scam check for an ERC20 on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum or Optimism: honeypot, buy/sell tax, mintable, owner can change balances, proxy, blacklist, open source, holder concentration, LP lock. Returns a 0-100 risk score, a verdict (low/medium/high) and the flags behind it. Use before buying or accepting a token. Deterministic, no LLM. Example output: {"chain":"base","address":"0x8335…2913","name":"USD Coin","symbol":"USDC","riskScore":5,"verdict":"low","flags":["proxy contract"],"buyTax":0,"sellTax":0,"holders":11378198,"top10HolderPercent":41.2,"isHoneypot":false,"source":"goplus+onchain"}. Price: $0.0072 USDC on Base via x402 (pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]).
name: token_safety
